egin{exercise} \end{exercise}[Connection on Lie groups] 1. ch4:4-11↗ prob:torsion-tensor Suppose $G$ is a Lie group.

(a) Show that there is a unique connection $ abla $ in $TG$ with the property that every left-invariant vector field is parallel.

(b) Show that the torsion tensor of $ abla $ (Problem 4-6) is zero if and only if $G$ is abelian. \end{exercise}
